title: Supplemental Benefit Allowances Embedded in Each Special Needs Plans Package
content:
A member's Special Needs Plans package carries supplemental benefits embedded in the plan: an allowance loaded to the card each calendar quarter, covered one-way trips for non-emergency transportation, allowances for dental care, eyewear and hearing aids, home-delivered meals after an inpatient discharge, and hours of in-home personal support. The figures each package carries are set out below.

| Plan benefit package | Allowance loaded each calendar quarter, USD | Covered one-way transportation trips per plan year | Dental allowance for the plan year, USD | Eyewear allowance for the plan year, USD | Hearing aid allowance per ear per plan year, USD | Home-delivered meals after an inpatient discharge | In-home personal support hours per plan year |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | 260.00 | 48 | 2500.00 | 400.00 | 1250.00 | 28 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | 320.00 | 96 | 3500.00 | 600.00 | 1750.00 | 56 | 120 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 90.00 | 24 | 1000.00 | 200.00 | 750.00 | 14 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 120.00 | 24 | 1500.00 | 300.00 | 1000.00 | 28 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 110.00 | 24 | 1000.00 | 200.00 | 750.00 | 14 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | 180.00 | 12 | 2000.00 | 350.00 | 1250.00 | 42 | 180 |

## What each column means

The quarterly allowance is the over-the-counter and healthy-food allowance loaded to the member's card each calendar quarter. The transportation column is the number of plan-covered one-way non-emergency transportation trips for the plan year. The dental column is the embedded comprehensive dental allowance for the plan year, the eyewear column the embedded eyewear allowance for the plan year, and the hearing column the embedded hearing aid allowance for each ear for the plan year. The meals column is the number of home-delivered meals covered after an inpatient discharge, and the last column the hours of in-home personal support the plan covers each plan year.

## Examples of the figures at work

A member of Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) has 320.00 USD loaded to the card each calendar quarter, and the hearing aid allowance of 1750.00 USD per ear means 3500.00 USD where aids are fitted for both ears in the same plan year.

A member of Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) has 24 covered one-way trips across the plan year, 14 home-delivered meals after an inpatient discharge, and 0 hours of in-home personal support, that package carrying none.
